import base64
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = pathlib.Path('/workspace/ai-cockpit')
RUNTIME = ROOT / 'runtime-target/release/ai-cockpit'
OUTPUT = ROOT / 'commands'
OUTPUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
name, program, *arguments = sys.argv[1:]
meta_path = OUTPUT / (name + '.json')
if meta_path.exists():
    raise SystemExit('Refusing to overwrite command observation: ' + name)
env = os.environ.copy()
env.update({
    'PATH': '/workspace/.cloud-tools/cargo/bin:' + env['PATH'],
    'CARGO_HOME': '/workspace/.cloud-tools/cargo',
    'RUSTUP_HOME': '/workspace/.cloud-tools/rustup',
    'CARGO_TARGET_DIR': '/workspace/ai-cockpit/target/wi1087-rebuild-p1',
    'CARGO_INCREMENTAL': '0',
    'CARGO_BUILD_JOBS': '1',
    'CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG': '0',
    'RUST_TEST_THREADS': '1',
    'RUST_TEST_NOCAPTURE': '1',
    'CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_UNKNOWN_LINUX_GNU_RUNNER':
        'bash /workspace/ai-cockpit/tests/ci/run_process_observer_test_runner.sh',
})
command = [str(RUNTIME), *arguments, '--repo', str(REPO)] if program == 'runtime' else [program, *arguments]
assert program == 'runtime' and arguments == ['verify', '--work-item', 'WI-1087-contract-authority-scope-and-expiry', '--workers', '1']
assert name == 'v04-native-coordinator'
bounded = command  # Native per-node deadlines govern; coordinator is not a verification node.

paths = ['crates/cockpit-core/src/clock.rs', 'crates/cockpit-core/src/lib.rs',
         'crates/cockpit-protocol/src/lib.rs', 'crates/cockpit-repository/src/authority.rs',
         'crates/cockpit-repository/src/lib.rs']
meta = {
    'schemaVersion': 1, 'kind': 'actual_native_serial_coordinator_observation', 'coordinatorPolicy': {'outerKillTimeoutSeconds': None, 'verificationNodeTimeoutSeconds': 600, 'workers': 1, 'nativePlan': 'r04-plan-after-timeouts.json', 'humanClarification': '900-second ceiling applies to verification execution nodes; coordinator may wait for all serial nodes', 'technicalDecision': 'relayed agent:Raydot approved one full native serial route; no Contract or assertion changes'},
    'command': bounded, 'cwd': str(REPO),
    'startedAt': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'processOnlyEnvironment': {key: env[key] for key in [
        'PATH', 'CARGO_HOME', 'RUSTUP_HOME', 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR', 'CARGO_INCREMENTAL',
        'CARGO_BUILD_JOBS', 'CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG', 'RUST_TEST_THREADS',
        'RUST_TEST_NOCAPTURE', 'CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_UNKNOWN_LINUX_GNU_RUNNER']},
    'runtimePath': str(RUNTIME), 'runtimeSha256': hashlib.sha256(RUNTIME.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'sourceHead': subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip(),
    'productSourceHashes': {p: hashlib.sha256((REPO / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths},
}
meta_path.write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=2) + '\n')
started = time.monotonic()
with (OUTPUT / (name + '.stdout')).open('wb') as out, (OUTPUT / (name + '.stderr')).open('wb') as err:
    p = subprocess.run(bounded, cwd=REPO, env=env, stdout=out, stderr=err)
meta.update({'exitCode': p.returncode, 'endedAt': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
             'elapsedSeconds': round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)})
for stream in ['stdout', 'stderr']:
    data = (OUTPUT / (name + '.' + stream)).read_bytes()
    meta[stream] = {'encoding': 'base64', 'bytes': len(data),
                    'rawSha256': 'sha256:' + hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
                    'data': base64.b64encode(data).decode('ascii')}
meta_path.write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'name': name, 'exitCode': p.returncode, 'elapsedSeconds': meta['elapsedSeconds'],
                  'runtimeSha256': meta['runtimeSha256'], 'path': str(meta_path)}))
for stream in ['stdout', 'stderr']:
    data = (OUTPUT / (name + '.' + stream)).read_text(errors='replace')
    if data:
        print(stream + ':\n' + (data if len(data) <= 24000 else data[-10000:]))
sys.exit(p.returncode)
